_note: A byte-fixed block body and the extrinsicsRoot that LayoutV0<Blake2Hasher> builds over it, in the shape chain/runtime/tests/fixtures/extrinsics_root_kat.json carries. That file is built by executing a real block and is the authority; this one exists so the two can be compared without running a runtime, and so the browser wallet can assert the same answer.
_shape: Each entry is one extrinsic as chain_getBlock returns it, compact length prefix included. Here: a timestamp inherent, a bare submit_private_batch carrying one output slot, and the coinbase inherent.
